requirements.text: Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 2+ years applied experience
Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code across the whole Software Development Life Cycle in a large corporate environment
Hands-on practical experience in software engineering experience as a full stack developer, with heavy emphasis on modern frontend development
Proficiency with modern frontend stacks (JavaScript/TypeScript) and React (Angular acceptable if strong React capability can be demonstrated)
Proficient in Java/Spring Boot, with experience applying microservices architecture patterns.
Strong working knowledge of HTML5, CSS, and preprocessors such as Sass/LESS

Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, testing, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs.
Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations.
Exposure to agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security
Demonstrated ability to independently solve design and functionality challenges with minimal supervision
Ability to work in large, collaborative teams with a passion to build an inclusive and innovative culture
Exposure to cloud technologies and/or relevant certification (e.g., AWS)
